description: §21.3.1 / §22.13 — a file-top `import:host` in a project with no `scrml.toml` fires E-IMPORT-008 exactly once: an absent manifest defaults `[capabilities] host-import` to "disabled". The imported name stays bound (no cascading E-SCOPE-001 on its use).
rationale: §22.13: "If the manifest is absent, the entry defaults to \"disabled\"" and "\"disabled\" — import:host declarations SHALL fire E-IMPORT-008 in every file of the project." §21.3.1: named bindings are in the logic scope as if plainly imported, so the use site raises no scope error.
